# agentic-swe

Reusable GitHub Actions and Skills Hub for agent-assisted software development.

## Skills Hub & Personal Vault

Available at https://agentic-swe.pages.dev/skills/.
- Provides official `@agentic-swe` skills (`@agentic-swe/pr-agent-setup`, `@agentic-swe/development-workflow`, `@agentic-swe/documentation-guard`).
- Supports interactive `{{VAR_NAME:default}}` template variables, rendered vs. raw `SKILL.md` inspection, bundled workflow files, and one-click install prompts/CLI commands for `.claude/skills`, `.agents/skills`, `.cursor/skills`, and `skills/`.
- Signed-in users can store `@handle/slug` skills in their private vault or mark them `public`, and generate temporary agent upload tokens at https://agentic-swe.pages.dev/skills/api/.
- Raw skill endpoint: `GET https://asia-southeast1-agentic-swe-skills.cloudfunctions.net/getRawSkill?owner=<handle>&slug=<slug>&VAR=value`.

## PR Agent

The PR Agent checks a PR against the base branch, optionally repairs conflicts using DeepSeek Harness, runs validation when invoked, and emits `result.json` plus `repair.patch`. It does not commit, push, create PRs, or merge.

Setup: add only `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. The default reusable workflow is read-only, checks out with non-persisted Git credentials, and skips external fork PRs. For untrusted forks use a separate isolated agent worker; publishing and auto-merge belong to a separate trusted consumer workflow.

Documentation: https://github.com/zc6600/agentic-swe/blob/main/docs/pr-agent.md

## Documentation Guard

Composite GitHub Action at `zc6600/agentic-swe@main`. Checks `README.md` (default 2,000 words) and other Markdown files (default 4,000 words); set `readme-limit` and `doc-limit` inputs to change them. No secrets required.
